title: Harold SMP
description: An open server side SMP with one of the largest worlds out there for you to explore. As you read this we're currently in Season 4 of the server. With each season change we reset the world and spice it up a bit. We also got Lore... (sometimes)
body:
# Welcome to Harold SMP

> ### **_[CHECK OUT THE MODPACK HERE!](https://modrinth.com/modpack/hrld4m)_**

## Harold SMP is an open Minecraft server for both Java Edition and Bedrock Edition!
  **The server uses a few server side mods, but feel free to add your own client side ones!**

## Player ran nations???
  **Anyone can start a nation, just keep your people happy. They may request a change in leadership otherwise...**

## The possabilities are endless on the Harold SMP, see you there?
  **At Harold, we host occasional events to keep our players entertained, at the end of each season. We strive to host a grand finale event each time, to keep players excited for the next season. We hope to see you online soon!**


**![A showcase of the server modded tarrain.](![Season 4 Spawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efb198f8071b1557034718aa01b9dde08d92dcd4.png))**
